text: The HTTP fixture sets imageRequested when its path is requested and then returns404. The test checks both the remoteContent warning and !imageRequested after message load. A later image decoder or opaque-response failure cannot make an attempted request look blocked in this probe. This is the test mechanism, not a result from executing it or complete coverage of content-policy exceptions.
title: The Exchange remote-content test detects request attempts before image success
